content:
Joining the ongoing deal on AirPods Pro 3 down at $50 off, today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by the ongoing pre-order discount on the next-gen Apple TV 4K pre-order (lower price and shipping faster than Apple in most locations) as well as Amazon re-stocking the silver model Apple HomeView. We also have 13-inch M5 MacBook Air models at $150 off, these TechWoven-style iPhone 18 Pro and Duo cases at up to $100 less than Apple’s (deals from $17), one of the first made for iPhone Duo MagSafe power banks, Anker’s 2026 Prime 25W 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger at 35% off, and more. Head below for a closer look at the details.

Land a solid deal on Apple’s best buds to pair with your Duo: AirPods Pro 3 now $50 off

It has been all about Amazon’s early pre-order discounts on Apple’s brand new HomeView (it is also still shipping the next-gen Apple TV 4K much sooner than Apple can), but this morning we are circling back to the wonderful AirPods Pro 3. You can still score Apple’s best AirPods at $50 off via Amazon.

Amazon is currently offering Apple’s AirPods Pro 3 down at $199 shipped.

Regularly $249, this is $50 off and the best deal around right now.

We were tracking AirPods Pro 3 at $179 during the fall Prime Day and we might see that deal return as soon as next month with the Black Friday festivities, but if you’re looking to land a set now they are sitting within $20 of the special holiday price.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)

Next-gen Apple TV 4K pre-order discount still live, and shipping faster than Apple

While most of Amazon’s HomeView discounts have disappeared now, its next-gen Apple TV 4K pre-order deal is still live. And it also appears to be shipping units faster than Apple can to several regions across the country.

Amazon brought back its light pre-order discount on Apple TV 4K this week, and you can secure it right now down at $289.99 shipped.

Apple is still managing to get pre-orders placed on it official site out somewhere within the last week of November and early December, as of the time of writing. The deal at Amazon certainly isn’t much, but it is charging less and delivering them faster to several of the folks around here right now.

This, as detailed in our HomeView coverage, could change at any minute, but as of right now Amazon is likely going to be your best bet for the new Apple TV 4K.

Folks certainly were not happy about the price of this thing when Apple revealed it last week, and understandably so, but if you are nonetheless looking to secure one on release day (or close to it), you’ll want to act fast.

All of that said, and as we detailed previously, you could always just keep the $240 in your pocket and spend $59 on the brand new Siri Remote instead. Apple is releasing the new Siri Remote that comes with the $299 Apple TV 4K on its own for $59 and it works with the Apple TV setup you already have. You’ll find more details on this move right here and some additional Apple deals to scope out this week below.

Amazon re-stocks silver model Apple HomeView with day 1 delivery

While delivery times will vary by region it would appear, Amazon has re-stocked the silver model Apple HomeView pre-order and does appear to be ready to get to your doorstep faster than Apple can.

The other three colors, including the launch deal on the Rose Pink model are still at the ready on Amazon with faster shipping than Apple for most locations across the country right now.

The Silver model appears to be the most popular option – delivery times on this one at Apple have slipped well into December at this point and it quickly went out of stock at Amazon.

However, HomeView with the Silver livery has returned at Amazon and it appears to be shipping on release day for several folks at 9to5 right now. This might not be the case for you, but it is worth

As of the time of writing, Apple has the earliest delivery window on the Silver model set to “Dec 3 – Dec 10,” and while this appears to be holding steady for now, it might also only be a matter of time before it slips deeper into December.

M5 MacBook Air is $150 off at Amazon today, but better deals could be coming soon

Amazon is now delivering solid price drops across the entire M5 MacBook Air lineup. Now down at the best prices we above tracked since Prime Day, almost all 13-inch configurations are now $150 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering $150 price drops across Apple’s latest 13-inch M5 MacBook Air lineup. There are a few outliers – select colors/storage configs, but they are all, by and large, sitting well below list.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,149 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (Reg. $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,649 (Reg. $1,799)

This starts things off with the 16GB/512GB model at $1,149 shipped, down from the regular $1,299, and carries right through to the upgraded 24GB/1TB model.

Considering how MacBook Air deals have gone since the late June price increase, these are solid prices. However, there are a couple things to keep in mind, and really more like one – Black Friday, and it’s coming quick now.

Earlier this month during the fall Prime Day event we caught what were easily the best collection of deals we had tracked in months on the M5 Air lineup. Just about every single configuration Amazon carries was at $200 off, instead of the $150 we have right now.

This would suggest there is a solid chance we see this same $200 price drop landing across the lineup as soon as next month as part of the Black Friday festivities, and quite possibly well before Thanksgiving.

Landing one at $150 off certainly isn’t a bad thing, but you will likely see this deal floating around all over the place and we just wanted to make it perfectly clear that it might only be a matter of weeks (or less) before we see these same machines at $200 off.

Official Apple iPhone 18 Pro/Max cases up to 32% off at Amazon, deals from $33

iPhone Duo pre-orders came and went super quickly yesterday and we have already detailed a number of case deals and new models for the popular Apple foldable, but this morning we are taking stock of the official 18 Pro options. Amazon is offering a number of Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models at discounted prices right now starting from $33 shipped – scope them out below.

Apple iPhone 18 Pro Silicone Cases

Apple iPhone 18 Pro TechWoven Cases

Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max Silicone Cases

Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max TechWoven Cases

These TechWoven-style iPhone 18 Pro and Duo cases are up to $100 less than Apple’s, deals from $17

We are tracking some discounts on Apple’s TechWoven iPhone 18 Pro cases, but this morning we taking a look at these much more affordable knock-off models from Mkeke. Nothing is going to replace the real thing, but if you’re not looking to spend upwards of $129, these models might be worth a look. The iPhone 18 Pro/Max models start from just $17 Prime shipped and the new Duo woven models start at under $30.

  • Mkeke iPhone Duo Woven Case from $30 (Reg. $36)
  • Mkeke iPhone 18 Pro Woven Case from $19 (Reg. $30)
  • Mkeke iPhone 18 Pro Max Woven Case from $17 (Reg. $30)

Apple makes a TechWoven model for the new Duo as well, known as the iPhone Duo Folio with Kickstand, but that one is only available with the complete flap covering the front display. Mkeke is offering up a woven option here for $100 less with the more standard form-factor – a backplate and edge for the front side.

Here are some details from the brand on its woven treatment: “Crafted with next-generation tech-woven fibers, this iPhone Duo case features a soft-touch finish. The elegant matte texture enhances grip while maintaining a sleek and modern appearance.”

Is this going to be as good a quality as the official Apple models? Almost certainly (definitely) not. But it is also a fraction of the price – you can buy 4+ of these for the price of one Apple iPhone Duo Folio.

Anker’s 2026 Prime 25W 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger is one of the best, now nearly 35% off

One of my personal favorite charging stations is on sale again folks – the Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger. Now $50 off the list price, you can now score it within a few bucks of the lowest price we have tracked on Amazon.

The official Anker Amazon storefront is now offering its Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger down at $99.73 shipped.

This deal is live on both the Radiant White and the Phantom Gray (a sort of Space Gray) colorways.

Carrying a regular $150 list price, this is just over $50 off for just under 35% in savings. Today’s offer is on par with most of the discounts we have seen on this model since release earlier this year save for the fall Prime Day price at just under $95.

There are plenty of 3-in-1 MagSafe charging stands that claim to work just as good on your desk as they will in your travel kit, and there are some solid options out there for sure, but this one is easily among the best if you ask me.

Get a closer look in our hands-on launch coverage right here.

This iPhone Duo MagSafe Power Bank with display is purpose-built for Apple’s new foldable

The new BMX Duo 5000mAh Power Bank is now available for purchase on Amazon at $79.99 shipped, and is one of the only models on the market specifically built for iPhone Duo.

SANDMARC debuts new full-grain leather iPhone Duo case with metal mount [Exclusive deal]

We have already covered the new SANDMARC iPhone 18 Pro leather cases, and now it’s time to take a look at its iPhone Duo model. The new SANDMARC iPhone Duo Pro Leather Case is now available for pre-order and you can get the lowest price possible using our exclusive 9TO510 promo code at checkout.

I have been a big fan of the SANDMARC leather iPhone cases for a few years now. They are, perhaps, not for everyone due to the industrial-grade and particularly functional metal housing employed to both safeguard your camera lenses and provide an attachment point for its lens add-ons, but they are very much for me.

  • SANDMARC iPhone Duo Pro Leather Case $81 (Reg. $90)
  • Using code 9TO510 at checkout

The new Duo model follows along the same lines as its 18 Pro models with a full-grain leather build and its patented aluminum mount “that delivers both camera protection and a secure connection to SANDMARC lenses and filters.”

You’ll also find a hard-shell guard for “added screen protection,” the expected MagSafe charging action, and an optional front guard – the brand says it “snaps in, with adhesive for a firmer hold” or you can “trim the pull tab to skip it.”

Burton Goods leather iPhone Duo cases are here: Up to 30% off for 9to5 readers

Don’t pay full list for Pitaka’s aramid fiber iPhone Duo Case, it’s down at $50 on Amazon

Don’t pay full price for iPhone Duo-ready Apple Pencil (USB-C), Amazon has it for less

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Baseus’ new Spacemate RD1 docks hit Amazon with smart displays, up to 140W charging, and 35% off launch deals
  • Sharge’s must-see metal power bank with smart display is $50 off (Amazon low)
  • This ridiculously thin 0.2-inch power bank will pair nicely with iPhone Duo, now at $18 all-time low (40% off)
  • UGREEN’s all-new 10,000mAh Smart Display power bank hits new low at $60
  • Anker’s all-new 45W–65W Burgundy Neo charger with Apple-like dynamic power hits lowest price at $20
  • Belkin Qi2.2 25W Pro magnetic charging stations deals live from $50 today

Apple’s most affordable new M6 Mac mini models are still up to nearly $150 off

While the first discounts are now live on the brand new Apple HomeView smart display alongside pre-orders for next-generation Apple TV 4K and the new Apple TV Siri Remote, we wanted to highlight the remaining Prime Day pricing on the latest M6 Mac mini models at up to $150 off.

These deals were particularly notable when they first landed at better than just $50 off ahead of Prime Day, and there are still a couple configurations you can score at a major discount right now:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB $780 (Reg. $899)
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB $950 (Reg. $1,099)

While we did see that entry 16GB/256GB model quickly drop $11 lower during the Prime event, that price did not last for long and it is currently settled back down at the initial Prime Big Deal Days price. The other model highlighted above is within $1 of the lowest price online to date and is delivering a particularly notable $149 off the list price.
